rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for a bird or birds in general.

example.english: This bird sings by the window every day.
example.traditional: 呢隻雀仔成日喺窗邊唱歌。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 zoek3 zai2 seng4 jat6 hai2 coeng1 bin1 coeng3 go1

rows.note: This is the formal or written general term for an animal bird rather than the usual casual choice.

example.english: This kind of bird mainly eats insects.
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 niu5 zyu2 jiu3 sik6 kwan1 cung4

rows.note: Use this when “bird” refers specifically to an attractive girl or woman.

example.english: When that attractive bird walked in, all the guys stared at her.
example.traditional: 嗰個靚女一入場，成班男仔都望住佢。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 leng3 neoi5 jat1 jap6 coeng4 seng4 baan1 naam4 zai2 dou1 mong6 zyu6 keoi5

rows.note: Use this for a girl or woman in a neutral way, when the attractive implication is weak or absent.

example.english: That bird asked me where the bus stop was.
example.traditional: 嗰個女仔問我巴士站喺邊。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 neoi5 zai2 man6 ngo5 baa1 si2 zaam6 hai2 bin1
